sites.name: Bloor
sites.notes: Production kitchen (cooks ahead and sends to Rexdale) and a shelter of about 30. Weekdays: dinner and snacks at 4 and 8 pm; weekends: lunch and dinner with a cold breakfast. Bloor's own service stays outside EXPO and DOOR. The separate drop-in kitchen is not a HOUSE site.

sites.name: Rexdale
sites.notes: Shelter of about 181 residents (about 172 plates a meal). Rexdale cooks fresh and assembles; Bloor sends what it cooks ahead.

sites.name: Lansdowne
sites.notes: Kitchen with about 40 of its own residents. Cooks for 1011 Lansdowne, Roncy and, in winter, the warming centre. DOOR numbers come after the staff rollout.

sites.name: 1011 Lansdowne
sites.notes: Housing project food-support program, about 20-30 a meal; also gets food-support items (not a plated meal). Its own kitchen is planned: then set kitchen to true, add its EXPO profile and change cookedBy.

sites.name: George Chuvalo Neighbourhood Centre
sites.notes: Community-space cafe kitchen that baked for Rexdale (cakes, earlier buns). Decommissioned for now, its staff placed at Lansdowne; may start up again. HUB shows it as a pickup point.

sites.name: Winter warming centre
sites.notes: About 20 in winter. The window is the usual season; correct it when this winter's dates are confirmed.
